title: Recommending Bacterial Cultivation Conditions from 16S rRNA
abstract: arXiv:2610.28310v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recommending bacterial cultivation conditions from sequence data is a challenging structured problem characterized by missing standardized benchmarks and limited use of sequence structure. To address this, we introduce DSNI, a benchmark of 65,023 bacterial strains with phylogeny-aware splits, pairing 16S rRNA sequences with four cultivation conditions (media, temperature, pH, oxygen). Exploiting the mosaic structure of 16S rRNA, where hypervariable regions support discrimination and conserved regions support primer design, we propose a Variability-Gated Encoder that learns position-dependent importance weights conditioned on biological features (region type, position, and local complexity). The gating module adds minimal overhead (1,280 parameters, <1%) while providing an explicit inductive bias valuable in low-data regimes. translated_title: 从16S rRNA序列推荐细菌培养条件
translated_abstract: 从序列数据中推荐细菌培养条件是一个具有挑战性的结构化问题，其特点是缺乏标准化基准数据集且对序列结构信息的利用有限。为解决这一问题，我们提出了DSNI——一个包含65,023个细菌菌株的基准数据集，采用系统发育感知的数据划分方式，将16S rRNA序列与四种培养条件（培养基、温度、pH值、氧气）配对。利用16S rRNA的马赛克结构特征——其中高变区域支持菌株鉴别，而保守区域支持引物设计——我们提出了一种可变性门控编码器，该编码器基于生物学特征（区域类型、位置和局部复杂度）学习位置相关的重要性权重。门控模块仅引入极小的额外开销（1,280个参数，不到1%），同时在低数据量场景中提供了有价值的显式归纳偏置。实验表明，可学习的门控机制使扁平Transformer的联合准确率提升了4.7%，并与之形成互补。
tldr: 提出包含65,023个菌株的DSNI基准数据集，并设计了一种利用16S rRNA高变与保守区域结构特征的可变性门控编码器，仅以不到1%的参数开销将细菌培养条件推荐的联合准确率提升4.7%。
en_tdlr: Introducing DSNI, a benchmark of 65,023 bacterial strains, and a Variability-Gated Encoder that exploits the mosaic structure of 16S rRNA to improve cultivation condition recommendation by 4.7% in joint accuracy with less than 1% parameter overhead.
